scale: 0 to 1. 0.5 is the population prior, not 'average person'. Values describe Pujo behaviour, never psychology.

dimensions.name: Night drive
dimensions.measures: How much of your Pujo happens after 11 pm.
dimensions.low: Home by ten. The night is for sleeping.
dimensions.mid: Out till one, then a cab home.
dimensions.high: Sees sunrise from the wrong side. Knows which stalls stay open at 3 am.
dimensions.notInverseOf: dawn — some people do both; they are scored separately on purpose.

dimensions.name: Dawn pull
dimensions.measures: Pull towards Pujo's mornings: Mahalaya at 4 am, anjali, empty pandals at 6 am.
dimensions.low: Has never seen a pandal before noon.
dimensions.mid: Makes it to Ashtami anjali, mostly.
dimensions.high: Alarm set for Mahalaya. Sees the pandal before the crowd does.

dimensions.name: Roaming radius
dimensions.measures: How far across the city one Pujo day travels.
dimensions.low: One para. Maybe the next one.
dimensions.mid: One side of the city per night.
dimensions.high: North, South, Salt Lake and Behala in one night.

dimensions.name: Planning
dimensions.measures: Planned route and optimisation versus drifting. Low is spontaneity, not disorganisation.
dimensions.mid: Has a rough list, abandons it happily.
dimensions.high: Spreadsheet, Metro timings, pre-Pujo visits to beat the queue.

dimensions.name: Crowd appetite
dimensions.measures: Whether the crush is the point or the problem.
dimensions.low: Avoids famous pandals at peak hours. Prefers bonedi baris and quiet lanes.
dimensions.mid: Tolerates queues for things worth it.
dimensions.high: The crowd is the Pujo. Sreebhumi on Saptami night is a feature.

dimensions.name: Squad size
dimensions.measures: The size of the group Pujo happens with.
dimensions.high: Fifteen people and a WhatsApp group with 400 unread messages.

dimensions.name: Roots
dimensions.measures: Belonging to a home pandal and taking part in its traditions: anjali, bhog, arati, volunteering, Bijoya.
dimensions.low: No home pandal. A visitor everywhere.
dimensions.mid: Goes back to the para on Ashtami.
dimensions.high: On the committee, or might as well be. Knows the dhaaki by name.
dimensions.note: Measures cultural participation, not faith. Never used for advertising or partner targeting.

dimensions.name: Heritage pull
dimensions.measures: Love for the old: sabeki idols, bonedi baris, Mahalaya radio, old Pujo songs, Pujabarshiki.
dimensions.low: Theme pandals only. 'Old' means last year.
dimensions.mid: Likes one bonedi bari per Pujo.
dimensions.high: Will cross the city for an ek-chala protima and a thakur dalan.

dimensions.name: Art eye
dimensions.measures: Reading a pandal as art: materials, artists, concept, light, craft.
dimensions.mid: Reads the placard at the big ones.
dimensions.high: Knows the artist's name before the placard does. Visits Kumartuli in September.

dimensions.name: Food drive
dimensions.measures: How much food shapes the route.
dimensions.low: Food is fuel. Eats whatever is closest.
dimensions.mid: Plans one good meal a day.
dimensions.high: The pandals are chosen by what's next to them.

dimensions.name: Shaaj
dimensions.measures: Investment in how you look at Pujo: outfits planned, looks per day, styling.
dimensions.low: Comfort first. Sneakers and a t-shirt.
dimensions.high: Five days, five looks, planned since July.

dimensions.name: Spotlight
dimensions.measures: Being seen: performing, dancing in front of people, posting, being the one in the photo.
dimensions.low: Behind the camera, or no camera at all.
dimensions.mid: Posts a dump at the end.
dimensions.high: In the centre of the dhunuchi circle, on everyone's story.

dimensions.name: Romance lens
dimensions.measures: Seeing Pujo as a love story: a date, a crush, or romanticising the city itself. Not relationship status.
dimensions.low: Love is a distraction. There are forty pandals left.
dimensions.high: Pujo is literally why they believe in love.
dimensions.note: Never inferred from anything except the person's own answers. Never shown to others without consent.

dimensions.name: Dhaak energy
dimensions.measures: How the body answers the dhaak: dancing, dhunuchi, bhasan, concerts.
dimensions.high: Dances the moment the dhaak starts. Asks for the dhunuchi.

preferenceFacets.note: Asked after the reveal. Used only to filter and rank recommendations. Never used to assign an archetype, so the identity can never become a class, diet or caste marker.
